text:
kevin: Quick thread to finalize launch gating for private deployments w/ customer-managed networks. Need final acceptance checklist, upgrade guarantees, and SOW language for preserved-egress asks.

rachel: Can you summarize the must-haves for GA?

kevin: Must-haves: 1) Installer mode `customer-managed` with a preflight that produces a signed audit.json and explicit egress IP mapping. 2) Patch upgrades as rolling deltas with abort; major upgrades require canary + staged rollout + telemetry rollback. 3) Delivery includes runbook, runbook checklist, and pilot acceptance criteria.

tony: Add: preflight must detect SNAT/NAT hairpin issues, dual-stack misconfigs, and unreachable control-plane endpoints. It should also propose remediation hints.

claire: Also require an operator flag to force relay fallback when BGP cannot be established: `--network-fallback relay`. Product wants relay-first for low-touch customers; ops wants BGP-certified for enterprise.

kevin: Proposed launch slices:
- Slice 1 (Low-touch): Relay allowed, minimal runbook, delta-patch support. Pilot: 1-2 customers.
- Slice 2 (Managed/BGP): Certified BGP peering + egress preservation + audit logs. Gate: lab peering pass + two pilot customers.
- Slice 3 (Contracted): Same as Slice 2 + SOW addendum for IP retention and defined maintenance windows.

rachel: For upgrades, define thresholds that auto-pause rollouts: control-plane RTT > 2x baseline; KV-store write latency > 150ms over 1m; failed healthcheck rate > 1%. Those feed an infra rollback API.

tony: Implementation notes: delta bundles must include manifest diffs + signatures. Preflight should be runnable offline (airgap) and emit the signed audit artifact customers can keep. Example CLI:
```
redwood-install --mode onprem --network customer-managed --preflight --audit-out audit.json
```
Preflight should include egress-map check and, when applicable, BGP session probe.

claire: SOW language: offer an optional "Preserve-Egress" addendum that lists customer obligations (static CIDR, no NAT changes during maintenance window, reachable peering ASN) and our commitments (we will not change egress IPs outside scheduled maintenance; rollback SLA). Legal to draft.

kevin: Pilot gating: Slice1 ready when preflight + delta dry-run succeed and pilot signs checklist. Slice2 ready after lab peering test, delta patch pilot, and signed audit artifacts from pilot customers. Slice3 needs legal signoff on SOW.

rachel: Ops hooks: we need telemetry tags on upgrade rollouts and a manual-override API to force rollback or accelerate. Also include an operator-visible timeline of expected token latency impact during upgrades.

tony: Timeline ask: engineering estimates 2w to ship preflight + audit artifact and basic delta apply. Lab harness for BGP + airgap testing is another 3w. Product scheduling Slice1 GA ~1w after preflight lands and a pilot week.

claire: Action items:
- tony: deliver preflight + audit.json prototype (+14d)
- rachel: draft slice definitions and pilot checklist (+10d)
- kevin: draft SOW Preserve-Egress template and maintenance window language (+12d)
- claire: create rollout telemetry spec for infra (+12d)

network-bot: Ticket created PRIV-6012 "preflight + signed audit artifact for customer-managed networking" assigned.

rachel: I'll coordinate pilot candidates with Field. Keep replies short.
